title: The Song of the Three Holy Children

verses.text: Then Azarias stood up and prayed on this manner, and opening his mouth in the midst of the fire, said,
Blessed art you, O Lord Alahayam of our fathers: your Name is worthy to be praised, and glorified for evermore.
For you are righteous in all the things that you have done to us: yea, true are all your workes: your ways are right, and all your iudgements truth.

In all the things that you have brought upon us, and upon the holy city of our fathers, even Jerusalem, you have executed true judgment: for according to truth and judgment, did you bring all these things upon us, because of our sins.
For we have sinned and committed iniquitie, departing from you.
In all things have we trespassed, and not obeyed your Commandments, nor kept them, neither done as you have commanded us, that it might go well with us.
Therefore all that you have brought upon us, and every thing that you have done to us, you have done in true judgment.
And you did deliuer us into the hands of lawlesse enemies, most hatefull forsakers and to an vniust King, and the most wicked in all the world.
And now we can not open our mouthes, we are become a shame, and reproch to your servants, and to them that worship you.
Yet deliuer us not up wholy for your Names sake, neither disanull you your Couenant:
And cause not your mercy to depart from us: for your beloued Abrahams sake: for your servant Isaacs sake, and for your holy Israels sake.
To whom you have spoken and promised, That you would multiply their seed as the starres of heaven, and as the sand that lyeth upon the sea shore.
For we, O Lord, are become lesse then any nation, and be kept under this day in all the world, because of our sins.
Neither is there at this time, Prince, or Prophet, or leader, or burnt offering, or sacrifice, or oblation, or incense, or place to sacrifice before you, and to find mercy.
Nevertheless in a contrite heart, and an humble spirit, let us be accepted.

Like as in the burnt offering of rammes and bullockes, and like as in ten thousands of fat lambes: so let our sacrifice be in your sight this day, and that we may wholy go after you: for they shall not be confounded that put their trust in you.
And now we do you follow, with all our heart, we fear you, and seeke your face.
Put us not to shame: but deale with us after your louing kindenesse, and according to the multitude of your mercies.
Deliuer us also according to your marueilous workes, and give glory to your Name, O Lord, and let all them that do your servants hurt be ashamed.
And let them be confounded in all their power and might, and let their strength be broken.
And let them know that you are Lord, the only Alahayam, and glorious over the whole world.
And the kings servants that put them in, ceased not to make the ouen hote with rosin, pitch, towe, and small wood.
So that the flame streamed forth above the fornace, forty and nine cubites:
And it passed through, and burnt those Caldeans it found about the fornace.
But the Angel of the Lord came downe into the ouen, together with Azarias and his fellowes, and smote the flame of the fire out of the ouen:
And made the mids of the fornace, as it had bene a moist whistling wind, so that the fire touched them not at all, neither hurt nor troubled them.
Then the three, as out of one mouth, praised, glorified, and blessed Alahayam in the fornace, saying;
Blessed art you, O Lord Alahayam of our fathers: and to be praised and exalted above all for ever.
And blessed is your glorious and holy Name: and to be praised and exalted above all for ever.
Blessed art you in the Temple of your holy glory: and to be praised and glorified above all for ever.
Blessed art you that behold the depths, and sit upon the Cherubims, and to be praised and exalted above all for ever.
Blessed art you on the glorious Throne of your kingdom: and to be praised and glorified above all for ever.
Blessed art you in the firmament of heaven: and above all to be praised and glorified for ever.
O all you workes of the Lord, blesse you the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.
O you heavens, blesse you the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.
O you Angels of the Lord, blesse you the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.
O all you waters that be above the heaven, blesse you the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.
O all you powers of the Lord, blesse you the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.
O you Sunne and Moone, blesse you the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.
O you starres of heaven, blesse you the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.
O every showre and dew, blesse you the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.
O all you windes, blesse you the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.
O you fire and heate, blesse you the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.
O you Winter and Summer, blesse you the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.
O you dewes and stormes of snow, blesse you the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.
O you nights and days, blesse you the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.
O you light and darkenesse, blesse you the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.
O you yce and colde, blesse you the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.
O you frost and snow, blesse you the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.
O you lightnings and clouds, blesse you the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.
O let the earth blesse the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.
O you mountaines and little hils, blesse you the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.
O all you things that grow on the earth, blesse you the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.
O you fountaines, blesse you the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.
O you seas and riuers, blesse you the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.
O you whales and all that move in the waters, blesse you the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.
O all you foules of the aire, blesse you the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.
O all you beasts and cattell, blesse you the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.
O you children of men, blesse you the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.
O Yahsharala blesse you the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.
O you priests of the Lord, blesse you the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.
O you servants of the Lord, blesse you the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.
O you spirits and souls of the righteous, blesse you the Lord, praise and exalt him above all for ever.
O you holy and humble men of heart, blesse you the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.

O Ananias, Azarias, and Misael, blesse you the Lord, praise and exalt him above all for ever: for he has deliuered us from hell, and saued us from the hand of death, and deliuered us out of the mids of the furnace, burning flame: even out of the mids of the fire has he deliuered us.
O give thanks to the Lord, because he is gracious: for his mercy endures for ever.
O all you that worship the Lord, blesse the Alahayam of gods, praise him, and give him thankes: for his mercy endures for ever.
